# tashan

> The intelligence layer for AI capabilities. tashan scores MCP servers and agent skills on public evidence — npm downloads and publish cadence, GitHub activity, registry status, and how often a server appears in real public agent configs. Nobody can pay to change a score, rank, or listing; payment buys depth and tooling only.

Generated: 2026-07-25. Capabilities tracked: 721 ranked. Every number below is re-derivable from public sources.

## How the score works

- **Trust** — composite of maintenance and freshness, gated by real adoption. 0–100.
- **Adoption** — npm download volume (log) blended with config-adoption reach across public repos.
- **Freshness** — recency of the most recent public activity: npm publish, git push, or release.
- **Maintenance** — maintainer count, release cadence and freshness, penalised for deprecated/archived.
- **Expertise** — an LLM grade of the capability's own documentation against a fixed rubric (deep / solid / thin / wrapper / slop). Only a subset is graded; ungraded means ungraded, not zero.

## Categories

- [Browser & Web](https://tashan.sh/category/browser.html) — 21 measured. Headless browsers, scraping, page automation, fetch. Top: chrome-devtools, firecrawl, trusty-squire.
- [Search](https://tashan.sh/category/search.html) — 34 measured. Web search, retrieval, and answer engines. Top: tavily, server, exa-mcp-server.
- [Database](https://tashan.sh/category/database.html) — 17 measured. SQL, NoSQL, vector stores, query & schema tools. Top: @supabase/mcp-server-supabase, @mokei/mcp-sqlite, read-only-local-mysql-mcp-server.
- [Dev Tools & CI](https://tashan.sh/category/devtools.html) — 78 measured. Git, GitHub, code, testing, build & CI. Top: everything, codescene-mcp-server, @cyanheads/git-mcp-server.
- [Cloud & Infra](https://tashan.sh/category/cloud.html) — 34 measured. Kubernetes, AWS, Docker, serverless, deploy. Top: @cloudbase/cloudbase, hostinger-api, kubernetes.
- [Files & Memory](https://tashan.sh/category/files.html) — 20 measured. Filesystem access, memory, knowledge graphs. Top: filesystem, memory, braincloud-mcp-helper.
- [Data & Analytics](https://tashan.sh/category/data.html) — 92 measured. Pipelines, analytics, spreadsheets, BI. Top: altmetric, sonar, statline.
- [Docs & Knowledge](https://tashan.sh/category/docs.html) — 47 measured. Docs lookup, notes, wikis, context retrieval. Top: @upstash/context7, @notionhq/notion-mcp-server, @ankimcp/anki-mcp-server.
- [Communication](https://tashan.sh/category/comms.html) — 38 measured. Slack, email, chat, calendars, meetings. Top: mcp, gotify-rmcp, apprise-rmcp.
- [Design](https://tashan.sh/category/design.html) — 46 measured. Figma, UI, images, creative & design tooling. Top: figma-developer, figma-console, mcp.
- [AI & Agents](https://tashan.sh/category/ai.html) — 51 measured. Reasoning, agents, model & LLM orchestration. Top: sequential-thinking, mcp, server.
- [Finance & Crypto](https://tashan.sh/category/finance.html) — 66 measured. Payments, markets, blockchain, wallets. Top: sap, mcp, mcp.
- [Productivity](https://tashan.sh/category/productivity.html) — 71 measured. Tasks, automation, workflows, personal tools. Top: mcp, server, atlassian.
- [Security](https://tashan.sh/category/security.html) — 58 measured. Auth, secrets, scanning, identity. Top: mcp, server, scf.

## Agent skills

- [Skills directory](https://tashan.sh/skills/) — 865 SKILL.md capabilities indexed from public repositories. Catalogued, not trust-ranked: a skill inside a monorepo has only its repository's maintenance signal, so a per-skill score would be meaningless.

## Citing tashan

Scores change as evidence changes; cite the date. Attribute as: tashan (tashan.sh), measured 2026-07-25. Full machine-readable export: https://tashan.sh/data/capabilities.json
